scripts.//-- dev --: Local dev servers: frontend on 7777, backend on 3001 (docs/STACK.md).
scripts.//-- build --: Build every workspace that has a build script (packages/* are consumed as TypeScript source and have none).
scripts.//-- check --: Typecheck. `check` runs every workspace (--no-bail: one failure does not hide the rest); `check:<surface>` runs one.
scripts.//-- test --: vitest. `test` runs every workspace (--no-bail); `test:<surface>` runs one. Engine tests use synthetic fixtures only.
scripts.//-- workspaces --: Run any script in one workspace: `pnpm frontend <script>`, `pnpm wrsm <script>`; `pnpm wrsm-cli wrsm run <dir>` runs the CLI under tsx.
